name: UNO English Pathfinder — Explore English Graph
purpose: Editable content graph for the ambient Explore English / screensaver-style Pathfinder landing experience.

editing_contract.plug_and_play: The web app should fetch this file at runtime. Content updates should not require changing scoring/pathfinding code.
editing_contract.stable_ids: Do not rename an id after release unless all edges and references are updated.

runtime_relationship_rules.faculty_peer_links: When a faculty node is focused, optionally surface active faculty sharing one or more topic nodes. Rank by shared-topic count, but do not invent direct collaboration.
runtime_relationship_rules.second_degree_exploration: Allow any focused node to reveal selected two-hop neighbors when useful, preserving the intermediate relationship in UI.
runtime_relationship_rules.uncertainty: Render confidence value ? as visibly uncertain metadata; do not silently upgrade it.
runtime_relationship_rules.link_status: Only render outbound links whose status is active unless an editor explicitly changes the behavior.
runtime_relationship_rules.center_blurb: Show center_blurb only for the focused/center node; labels remain terse elsewhere.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use newer official UNO promotion announcements where available, while retaining directory_role verbatim in faculty metadata.

source_conflicts.issue: Concentration pages may name emeritus or no-longer-current faculty
source_conflicts.resolution: Active faculty membership is controlled only by the current English directory section above the Emeritus heading. Emeritus names are not faculty nodes.

source_conflicts.issue: Current offering dates for some recurring courses/events are not explicit
source_conflicts.resolution: Availability is stored as ? rather than implied.

excluded_from_active_faculty.rule: Anyone listed in the current directory under Emeritus Faculty is excluded from active-faculty nodes, even if older concentration pages still list them.

research_notes: Source review prioritized current UNO English pages, current UNO catalog pages, current university research/opportunity pages, and current official UNO promotion announcements.
Personal/research websites are included only when linked from an official UNO faculty profile in this version.
Faculty-to-faculty exploration is best derived from shared topic nodes at runtime rather than hardcoding a dense matrix of pairwise edges.
Opportunity availability changes faster than expertise/program structure. Keep availability metadata date-stamped and re-verify before production releases.

As of 2026-10-03, SoLaS lists two current projects (English Spoken in Omaha; English and Cebuano Onomatopoeias), both with ongoing recruitment, and offers paid RAs when funding permits plus volunteer research internships.
Bouteloua LitART Fest 2026 is scheduled for 2026-10-04 at Glacier Creek Preserve; Tammie Kennedy is a participating author and The Linden Review sponsors the Writing about Illness & Health panel.

hygiene.duplicate_rule: Active nodes may not share the same normalized human-facing label unless intentionally duplicated via alias_of or intentional_duplicate.
hygiene.review_focus: Front-facing nodes use concise center_blurb copy of about ten words; topic-level near-duplicates are reviewed rather than blindly merged.
hygiene.social_media_rule: Social Media is a resource/community hub, not an expertise node; user-provided social links are labeled as such until independently verified.
